nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file listing required and optional variables for the docker-compose stack: LLM API keys (Gemini, Groq), Postgres credentials, MinIO/S3 storage settings, and the frontend API base URL.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README for the Docker-Compose launcher of the YouTube Video to Structured Course Generator, covering quick start, usage, .env configuration, changes made vs. the upstream project, troubleshooting, and manual (non-Docker) development instructions.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose stack definition that launches the full local application: Postgres for persistence, MinIO for S3-compatible frame storage plus a bucket-init job, Jaeger for tracing, the FastAPI/LangGraph backend with a DB-init job, and the nginx-served React frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses depends_on with service_healthy/service_completed_successfully conditions to sequence one-shot init containers (minio-init, backend-init) ahead of the services that need them.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Minimal root-level npm manifest declaring a single dependency, remark-breaks, likely used for markdown line-break rendering somewhere in the project's tooling or frontend.

nodes.name: postgres
nodes.summary: Postgres 16 Alpine database service providing course/JSONB persistence, with a healthcheck gating dependent services.

nodes.name: minio
nodes.summary: MinIO service providing local S3-compatible object storage for extracted video frame images, exposing the S3 API and web console.

nodes.name: minio-init
nodes.summary: One-shot bootstrap job that waits for MinIO to be healthy, creates the storage bucket, and sets it to public-read for local image serving.

nodes.name: jaeger
nodes.summary: Jaeger all-in-one service acting as the OpenTelemetry/OTLP trace collector and UI for the stack.

nodes.name: backend
nodes.summary: FastAPI + LangGraph agent backend service, built from ./backend, wired to Postgres, MinIO/S3, and Jaeger via environment variables, exposed on port 8000.

nodes.name: backend-init
nodes.summary: One-shot database schema initialization job that runs scripts/init_db.py against the backend image to create the courses table once Postgres is healthy.

nodes.name: frontend
nodes.summary: React SPA built from ./frontend and served by nginx on port 3000, configured with the backend API base URL at build time.
